title: Discord client data
whyItMatters: Discord caches servers, direct messages and attachments and keeps a login token locally. The token is enough to take over the account until the password is changed.
source: Discord desktop is an Electron app that stores its user data in the app-data folder (leveldb caches, logs): https://github.com/discord/discord-api-docs
notes: Stable client. Discord Canary, PTB and Development builds use discordcanary, discordptb and discorddevelopment folders next to it. Versioned folders under discord hold the app itself.
